experience.description: Building robust backend systems and AI-powered solutions. Mentored a new team member in test automation methodologies, achieving a 30% increase in coding efficiency. Enhanced the framework and refactored code, aligning with evolving project requirements, leading to a 20% improvement in overall framework performance.

Developed invoice bill generation functionality and improved user interface with Dart and Flutter. Fixed 30+ bugs, enhancing software performance and user experience. Reduced user-reported issues by 15% and increased user satisfaction ratings by 25% through targeted UI improvements and code optimizations.
